Title: Registration form displays all required fields
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/register | 2. Observe the registration form
Expected Result: All required fields displayed: First name Last name DOB Street Postal code City State Country Phone Email Password. Submit button visible.

Title: Password requirements list shown on password field focus
Expected Result: Requirements list shown: 8+ chars upper+lower number special character.

Title: Password requirements update in real time as user types
Preconditions: User is on registration page password focused
Test Steps: 1. Focus Password field | 2. Type a | 3. Type aB1! then aB1!aaaa
Expected Result: Requirement indicators update immediately as each rule is met. All criteria fulfilled after full valid password.

Expected Result: Strength indicator shows Weak. Progress bar ~20%.

Expected Result: Strength indicator shows Moderate. Progress bar ~40%.

Expected Result: Strength indicator shows Strong. Progress bar ~60%.

Expected Result: Strength indicator shows Very Strong. Progress bar ~80%.

Title: Successful registration with valid data
Preconditions: User not logged in unique email available
Test Data: Unique email + Welcome@123 + valid profile data
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/register | 2. Fill all valid fields | 3. Submit
Expected Result: Account created. Redirected to /auth/login. Confirmation email sent.

Title: Registration blocked for duplicate email
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/register | 2. Fill valid data with existing email | 3. Submit
Expected Result: Error: Email is already in use. Registration not completed.

Title: Registration rejected with weak password
Test Steps: 1. Fill valid data with weak password | 2. Submit
Expected Result: Submission blocked or validation error. Account not created.

Title: Registration rejected with invalid email format
Test Steps: 1. Fill valid data except invalid email | 2. Submit
Expected Result: Email validation error shown. Account not created.

Title: Registration rejected when required fields empty
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/register | 2. Submit without filling fields
Expected Result: Required field validation errors shown. Account not created.

Test Data: First name Test | Last name User | DOB 1990-05-15 | Street 123 Main Street | Postal 12345 | City New York | State NY | Country United States | Phone 5551234567 | unique email | Password Welcome@123

Title: Login form displays email password and Google sign-in

Expected Result: Error: Account locked too many failed attempts. HTTP 423. Correct password rejected.

Title: Admin account never locked after failed attempts

Expected Result: Admin not locked. Login with correct password succeeds.

Title: Disabled account cannot log in

Expected Result: Error: Account disabled. User not authenticated.
